claim_boundary: C009 adds nine inherited descendants and rejects one under-specified C008 node. None is proved or certified novel.

hypotheses.title: Boolean-Cube Affine Theta-Rank Invariance Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Let I be the vanishing ideal of a finite subset S of the Boolean cube. Under any coordinate permutation and any coordinate complementation x_i -> 1-x_i, the theta rank of I is unchanged, and every level-k theta certificate is transported with the same degree and polynomially related rational bit complexity.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This isolates harmless affine symmetries inside H072: any genuine theta-rank collapse must come from projection, XOR substitution, auxiliary-variable extension, or another non-isomorphic operation.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: separate degree-preserving Boolean-cube isomorphisms from the operations that can actually weaken a theta lower bound.
hypotheses.next_gate: Write the substitution proof at the quotient-ring level, verify transport of k-sos certificates in both directions, and formalize the bit-length accounting.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H075 extracts the exactly invertible degree-preserving part of the broad affine preprocessing in H072 and turns it into a bidirectional certificate-preservation lemma.
falsification_conditions: A Boolean-cube permutation or complementation that changes the minimum theta-body level needed for exactness.
A family whose transported certificates require superpolynomially larger rational bit length despite the substitution using only 0, 1, and -1 coefficients.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The claim covers only coordinate permutations and complementations. General GF(2) XOR substitutions and existential projections are not degree-preserving real affine automorphisms of the Boolean coordinate ring.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Scope Projection Theta-Rank Collapse Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit family of finite Boolean ideals I_n with theta rank n^Omega(1) and polynomial-size extension ideals J_n using only constant-scope defining equations such that projecting the real variety of J_n onto the original coordinates gives exactly the variety of I_n, while J_n has O(1) theta rank.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: A direct monotonicity argument for H071 would fail even for local extension variables; any successful lower bound would need to charge extension dependency depth, global sharing, or another structural resource.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: search for an explicit auxiliary-variable collapse that attacks the unproved preservation core of H071.
hypotheses.next_gate: Enumerate small Boolean varieties and bounded-scope extensions, measure exact theta rank symbolically where possible, and search for the first strict rank collapse before attempting an infinite construction.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H076 reverses H071's desired preservation theorem and makes the auxiliary-variable escape route itself an explicit falsifiable construction problem.
falsification_conditions: A theorem proving theta rank cannot decrease by more than a constant factor under every constant-scope exact extension.
Failure to produce any strict collapse in a complete bounded-size enumeration together with a proof that the enumeration covers all extension types at that size.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Arbitrary nonlocal extensions can encode hard semantics; H076 specifically requires constant-scope equations and exact projection.

hypotheses.title: Bounded-Depth Local-Extension Theta Stability Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed scope s and dependency depth d there is a function q_{s,d} such that, whenever a Boolean ideal I is represented by an exact extension ideal J whose auxiliary variables are defined by an acyclic fan-in-at-most-s circuit of depth at most d, theta-rank(I) is at most q_{s,d}(theta-rank(J)).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Any family with unbounded original theta rank would remain hard for bounded-depth local lift grammars, salvaging a rigorously limited form of H071 and directly constraining H045.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: identify dependency depth as the resource that may control whether auxiliary variables can collapse theta rank.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove certificate substitution for depth one, derive the degree blow-up explicitly, and then induct on the extension circuit depth.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H077 weakens H071 from arbitrary polynomially many local extensions to acyclic bounded-depth definitions, the smallest class for which a compositional substitution proof may work.
falsification_conditions: A depth-one constant-scope exact extension family with unbounded original rank and bounded lifted rank.
A certificate whose substitution through one local definition causes unbounded degree growth independent of scope.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The conjecture does not cover unbounded-depth extension circuits or unrestricted reuse of auxiliary variables.

hypotheses.title: Canonical Bounded-Level Theta-Twin Family Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed k there are explicit polynomial-time constructible satisfiable and unsatisfiable CNF families F_n^+ and F_n^- and one fixed canonical Boolean-ideal encoding E such that the level-k theta relaxations of E(F_n^+) and E(F_n^-) are both feasible, attain the same registered objective values, and admit moment matrices agreeing on a fixed canonical list of degree-at-most-2k monomials after variable renaming.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: No algorithm restricted to that canonical bounded-level theta profile can decide SAT universally, providing a precise replacement for rejected H074 and a reusable counterfamily for H070 and H045.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: replace the undefined all-statistics profile of H074 by one finite coordinate-normalized moment comparison.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fix the encoding and monomial order, construct finite SAT/UNSAT collisions for k=1, and then search for a pseudocalibrated or lifted infinite family.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H078 salvages H074 by fixing one encoding, one finite monomial basis, one equality notion, and one explicit SAT/UNSAT family for each level.
falsification_conditions: A proof that the chosen canonical level-k profile necessarily separates satisfiable from unsatisfiable instances.
A polynomial-time separator using only the registered profile coordinates and objective values.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Equality is required only for the fixed canonical profile, not for every conceivable statistic or preprocessing grammar.

hypotheses.title: Local Conflict-Graph Theta Barrier Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: Every SAT-to-independent-set compiler that uses one constant-size vertex gadget per clause, adds edges and auxiliary vertices only from constant-radius clause-variable neighborhoods, and preserves satisfiability by an independent-set target M_F fails to create an inverse-polynomial Lovasz-theta gap on an explicit infinite unsatisfiable 3CNF family.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H070 cannot be realized by a purely local conflict-graph redesign; a successful theta compiler must use nonlocal structure, growing dependency depth, or a stronger hierarchy.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: extend the known failure of the generic conflict graph into a precisely delimited local-gadget barrier.
hypotheses.next_gate: Formalize the compiler class as a finite graph-transduction grammar and test whether the Feige-Ofek witness or a lifted random-CSP family is preserved under each gadget.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H079 turns H070's known generic-reduction weakness into a quantified attack on all constant-radius graph gadgets rather than one fixed reduction.
falsification_conditions: A local compiler in the stated class with a proved inverse-polynomial theta gap for every unsatisfiable CNF.
A theorem showing the Feige-Ofek obstruction is destroyed by a permitted constant-radius gadget family.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The claim does not rule out global polynomial-time compilers or higher theta/SoS levels.

hypotheses.title: Nonlocality-or-Depth Necessity for Universal Theta Compilation
hypotheses.statement: Any compiler satisfying H070 must, on infinitely many inputs, use at least one of the following resources: gadget scope omega(1), extension dependency depth omega(1), a global spectral operation not expressible by a fixed local grammar, or a theta/SoS level growing with input size.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The search for H070 would be reduced from arbitrary graph gadgets to four explicit nonlocal resources, while H043-H045 would lose the possibility of a fixed finite local exact grammar.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_BRIDGE: convert local theta and SoS lower bounds into a structural necessity theorem for any surviving constructive route.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove that the negation of all four resources places the compiler inside the local class of H079 or the bounded-depth class of H077.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H080 synthesizes the local graph barrier and extension-depth analysis into a disjunction of resources that every universal compiler must expose.
falsification_conditions: A universal H070 compiler with constant scope, constant dependency depth, no global operation, and constant theta level.
Failure of the proposed containment from bounded resources into H079/H077's attacked classes.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: This is a necessity statement, not a construction of a SAT algorithm or a complexity separation.

hypotheses.title: Conditioned Rational Theta-Certificate Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For the rational graph SDPs produced by H070, if the primal and dual feasible regions have inverse-polynomial Slater margins and the optimum is separated from the decision threshold by at least 1/poly(N), then there exist rational primal and dual approximate certificates of polynomial bit length whose exact arithmetic verification certifies the correct side of the threshold.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H070's numerical SDP step could be converted into an independently checkable bit-model decision certificate under explicit conditioning assumptions.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: separate the combinatorial theta-gap obligation from the numerical conditioning and exact-certificate obligation.
hypotheses.next_gate: Prove a quantitative rounding lemma from the Slater and objective margins and implement exact rational verification for the standard theta SDP.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H081 narrows H070/H073 to a condition-number-aware certificate theorem rather than assuming every SDP optimum has a short exact witness.
falsification_conditions: A rational theta SDP with the stated margins and threshold gap for which every valid rational certificate has superpolynomial bit length.
A counterexample where rational rounding changes the certified side despite the promised margins.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Without explicit conditioning margins, low-degree or small SDP certificates may require exponentially many bits.

hypotheses.title: Fixed-Level Theta-SoS Bit-Equivalence Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed k and the canonical Boolean ideals used in C009, level-k theta-body separation certificates and degree-2k Sum-of-Squares proofs over the same quotient ring translate in both directions with polynomial overhead in instance size and coefficient bit length, provided the conditioned certificate assumptions of H081 hold.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Theta experiments and theta-rank lower bounds could be connected to the existing SoS branch H045 with explicit proof-size and bit-complexity accounting.
hypotheses.proof_role: DIRECT_BRIDGE: specialize H073 to a fixed-level, fixed-encoding theorem that is small enough to formalize and independently verify.
hypotheses.next_gate: Write both translations for k=1, define the Gram and moment matrix conventions, and prove exact coefficient bounds under H081.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H082 replaces H073's unbounded-level broad equivalence by one fixed-level Boolean specialization with explicit conditioning hypotheses.
falsification_conditions: A fixed-level theta certificate satisfying H081 whose smallest corresponding SoS proof has superpolynomial size or bit length.
A degree-2k SoS proof in the fixed quotient ring with no polynomially related theta separation certificate.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The statement does not claim a uniform polynomial translation when k grows with N or when conditioning fails.

hypotheses.title: Restriction-Robust Affine-Core Theta Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There is an explicit mixed XOR/non-affine CNF family F_n and constants delta,c>0 such that every restriction leaving at least n^delta live variables, followed by all exact Gaussian eliminations and coordinate symmetries allowed by H042 and H075, leaves a residual Boolean ideal requiring theta/SoS degree at least n^c unless the representation size becomes superpolynomial.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would supply H072 with a restriction-robust explicit target, strengthen H062, and create a family suitable for lower-bound transfers to parity-aware proof systems.
hypotheses.proof_role: ADVERSARIAL_TARGET: demand a hard residual invariant that survives both affine preprocessing and the restrictions used by lower-bound arguments.
hypotheses.next_gate: Choose an explicit expander-based XOR core plus a deterministic non-affine gadget and prove pseudoexpectation restriction closure before handling local cardinality definitions.
hypotheses.delta_from_parents: H083 adds restriction robustness and separates harmless coordinate symmetries from Gaussian projection, making the target compatible with standard lower-bound induction techniques.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-size permitted preprocessing and restriction reducing the selected family to bounded theta/SoS degree.
A proof that every candidate mixed family loses its pseudoexpectation under a restriction leaving n^delta variables.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The explicit family and restriction theorem are both unproved; random existence alone is insufficient.
